# AI Office Dollhouse 0.3.9

- Normal installation now adds the official user-level Codex lifecycle hook and leaves trust review to Codex's standard `/hooks` flow.
- Before that hook is trusted, the bounded read-only session observer continues to show evidence-backed local activity without reading prompts, responses, or tool contents.
- Local browser and visual-test data no longer enter product packages; released scenes remain free of fixed people so only real observed workers appear.

## Install

1. Download `AI-Office-Dollhouse-v0.3.9-win-x64.zip`.
2. Extract the archive and run `Install-AI-Office-Dollhouse.cmd`.
3. In Codex, open `/hooks` and review the AI Office Dollhouse hook to enable the full lifecycle event stream.

<details>
<summary>繁體中文</summary>

- 正常安裝現在會加入 Codex 的官方使用者層 lifecycle hook，並交由 Codex 標準 `/hooks` 流程審閱信任。
- 在 hook 尚未信任時，有界的唯讀 session observer 仍會顯示有證據的本機活動，不讀取提示詞、回覆或工具內容。
- 本機瀏覽器與視覺測試資料不再進入正式封裝；發行場景不含固定人物，只呈現實際觀測到的工作者。

### 安裝

1. 下載 `AI-Office-Dollhouse-v0.3.9-win-x64.zip`。
2. 解壓縮後執行 `Install-AI-Office-Dollhouse.cmd`。
3. 在 Codex 輸入 `/hooks`，審閱 AI Office Dollhouse hook，即可啟用完整 lifecycle 事件。

</details>
